questions.question: Choose the correct form of the verb in brackets to complete the sentence: She said that she (have) ________ seen the film before.
options: has
had
would have
was having

questions.question: Select the correct option to complete the sentence: By the time we arrived, the meeting (already start) ________.
options: had already started
has already started
already had started
already started

questions.question: Which sentence correctly reports the statement: 'I am writing an email to my boss.'?
options: She said she is writing an email to her boss.
She said she was writing an email to her boss.
She said she would be writing an email to her boss.
She said she was going to write an email to her boss.
questions.answer: She said she was writing an email to her boss.

questions.question: Choose the correct reported speech form: 'If I find her address, I will call her.'
options: He said that if he found her address, he would call her.
He said that if he found her address, he would call her.
He said that if he had found her address, he would call her.
He said that if he finds her address, he will call her.
questions.answer: He said that if he found her address, he would call her.

questions.question: Select the correct option to complete the sentence: Despite the bad weather, the event (take) ________ place as planned.
options: took
had taken
was taken
was taking

questions.question: Which of the following is the correct way to report the question: 'How much does this cost?'
options: He asked how much did that cost.
He asked how much that costed.
He asked how much that costs.
He asked how much that cost.
questions.answer: He asked how much that cost.

questions.question: Choose the correct form to complete the sentence: If I (be) ________ you, I would take that job.
options: was
were
am
would be

questions.question: Select the correct reported speech form: 'I wish I had studied harder for the exam.'
options: She said she wished she had studied harder for the exam.
She said she wished she would study harder for the exam.
She said she wished she had studied harder for the exam.
She said she wished she studies harder for the exam.
questions.answer: She said she wished she had studied harder for the exam.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly reports the imperative: 'Don't forget to bring your passport.'?
options: He told me not to forget to bring my passport.
He told me don't forget to bring my passport.
He said forget to bring your passport.
He said don't forget to bring your passport.
questions.answer: He told me not to forget to bring my passport.

questions.question: Choose the correct option to complete the sentence: By next year, they (move) ________ into their new house.
options: will have moved
are moving
have moved
will move
